content.text:
I removed the Friday 15:00 start cutoff from `src/solution.py`. I didn't run or test the edited file.

I deleted the Friday detection and the `latest_start` cap that went with it. Friday now follows the same rules as every other day. Those rules are 09:00–17:00 working hours, no starts during lunch (12:00–13:00), no overlap with existing events, and 15-minute steps.

I left the rest alone, including the date-to-weekday conversion at the top of the function. The conversion no longer affects the result, since only the Friday check used the weekday.
